notes: Main source: Cornell CV PDF (vita jz638; about 2025 vintage). Included refereed articles, edited-volume chapters (venue prefixed 'Book chapter:'), papers under review and working papers; skipped nonrefereed items, reprints, the Choices magazine piece and the Water Resources Update note. Working-paper years from the CV (2022-2025). Homepage listed Fan et al. as a 2022 working paper but the CV shows it published (Economic Inquiry 2025); CV used. Homepage research page lists no 2025-26 items; no newer CV was readable, so later 2026 items may be missing. The 2022 Economic Inquiry and similar year values follow the CV. URLs left blank where the CV gave no DOI.
